title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - NominalPowerLimit
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/NominalPowerLimit. A device may have nominal power consumption and/or production values that are defined by the manufacturer and must not be exceeded, so that the power limit must stay within these constraints. Subclass of PowerLimit per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the PowerLimit model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'NominalPowerLimit'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasNominalConsumption.description: Property. The relationship between the nominal power limit and the value indicating the max limit consumption. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.

unitCode.description: Unit of measure code (UN/CEFACT common code where applicable).

hasNominalProduction.description: Property. The relationship between the nominal power limit and the value indicating the max limit production. Models saref:PropertyValue (core SAREF, not itself translated in this candidate): a value with its unit of measure.
